card.situation:
VA Technology Acquisition Center is seeking sources for DASL Bridge Support Services — enterprise data management, business architecture, data engineering, and Palantir/Foundry-compatible governance support for the NCA EISS modernization effort (R499--VA-26-00068264).
This Sources Sought reached the owner because Sooner Systems LLC holds NAICS 541512 and SDVOSB status; a response here means submitting a capability statement (RFI response), not a proposal.
reasons_for: Firm holds SDVOSB status and NAICS 541512, making it formally eligible to respond to this unrestricted Sources Sought notice [profile: SDVOSB eligibility, NAICS 541512 match].
22 cleared staff at Secret level satisfies the background investigation roster requirement and demonstrates a security-ready workforce [54a51abc-f36796d8-p1-bae7510d].
24x7 NOC in Norman, OK fulfills the contractor-facility performance requirement and supports the one-hour vulnerability notification obligation [54a51abc-f36796d8-p1-33ee0486].
reasons_against: VA has stated intent to solicit this requirement as a sole source, meaning no competitive opportunity exists regardless of the firm's qualifications ["The purpose of this Amendment is to advise all prospective vendors that VA intends to solict this requirement as a sole source."].

The firm has zero capability in the core technical areas — enterprise data management, business architecture, data engineering, Palantir/Foundry, data reconciliation, or EISS modernization — leaving 16 of 29 requirements as outright gaps [54a51abc-f36796d8-p1-30e64ff8].

No past performance record matches data engineering, business architecture, Palantir/Foundry, or NCA/EISS modernization, violating owner rule ss-pp and leaving the capability statement without credible evidence of relevant experience [profile: matched past performance — none].

drafts.capability_statement:
Sooner Systems LLC — Capability Statement
R499--VA-26-00068264 | DASL Bridge Support Services | NAICS 541512

Sooner Systems LLC is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) headquartered in Norman, Oklahoma, providing IT support, cybersecurity, and infrastructure services to federal agencies under NAICS 541512.

Our relevant capabilities include:

• Cybersecurity & Compliance: RMF/ATO documentation, vulnerability management (ACAS/Nessus), CMMC Level 2 self-assessment, ITIL 4 and Security+ certified staff, and NIST SP 800-series framework alignment.
• Infrastructure & Systems Administration: Microsoft 365 and Azure administration, desktop and network administration, and Windows 11/M365 environment support consistent with VA standard computer configuration requirements.
• Cleared Workforce: 22 staff holding active Secret clearances, with established background investigation management processes. We can deliver a compliant contractor staff roster within 3 business days of award.
• Incident Response: 24x7 NOC operations in Norman, OK, supporting one-hour vulnerability notification and continuous monitoring obligations.
• Contractor Facility: All work can be performed from our Norman, OK facility, satisfying the contractor-facility performance requirement.

Sooner Systems LLC acknowledges that the core data engineering, Palantir/Foundry, business architecture, and NCA EISS modernization requirements of this effort represent capability areas outside our current service lines. We respectfully submit this statement to inform the VA's market research and welcome any follow-on dialogue regarding scope or teaming opportunities.

Point of Contact: [Owner name, title, phone, email]

[54a51abc-a50d6cef-p1-fe39f381]

[54a51abc-f36796d8-p1-60e0b443, 54a51abc-f36796d8-p1-15bb2338]

All deliverables must be compatible and interoperable with VA's existing Palantir Foundry environment, supporting data reconciliation, cross-system interoperability, and enterprise governance across NCA, OIT, and DoW stakeholders. quotes: The purpose of this Amendment is to advise all prospective vendors that VA intends to solict this requirement as a sole source.
The contract shall provide enterprise data management, business architecture, data engineering, and governance support services for the NCA EISS modernization effort.

Services shall include data reconciliation, source system assessment, business process analysis, data model development, Enterprise Information Model alignment, dashboard and reporting requirements, configuration support, and coordination with DoW stakeholders for cemetery operations, burial eligibility, interment scheduling, and person-level record reconciliation.
The PoP shall be six (6) months from date of award.

All deliverables shall be compatible and interoperable with VA's existing Palantir Foundry environment, supporting data reconciliation, cross-system interoperability, and enterprise governance across NCA, OIT, and DoW stakeholders.
Tasks under this PWS shall be performed at Contractor facilities.
